project_title: Amazon Multi-Marketplace Seller Finance & P&L Dashboard
design_archetype: Swiss & Precision Finance (Archetype 4 with Vibrant Emerald & Slate Accents)
language: Turkish (UI Labels and Messages) with Multi-Currency Financials ($ USD, CAD$, MXN$, £ GBP, € EUR, A$ AUD)

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.kpi_value: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-mono text-slate-900
hierarchy.body: text-sm text-slate-6 shadow-none font-normal leading-relaxed text-slate-600
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6)
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto
layout_and_spacing.header_height: h-16 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm sticky top-0 z-40
layout_and_spacing.sub_header: bg-slate-900 text-white px-6 py-3 border-b border-slate-800

top_navbar.title: Amazon Seller Suite - Kar/Zarar & Bakiye Takip
elements: Store Switcher Dropdown (e.g. 'Alfa Global Store', 'Mega Retail US')
Marketplace Selector Pill/Dropdown with Flags (US 🇺🇸, CA 🇨🇦, DE 🇩🇪, etc.)
Currency Auto-Toggle / Consolidated FX Rate Converter Indicator

core_views.title: Ana Dashboard
widgets: KPI Summaries with Month-over-Month Delta Badges
Gelir ve Kar Trend Grafiği (Recharts Area/Line Chart)
Pazar Yeri Dağılımı (Recharts Pie/Donut Chart by Marketplace)
Son İşlemler & Hızlı Ekleme Kısa Yolları

core_views.title: Gelir Kaydı (Sales & Income)
features: Manual Income Entry Form (Date, Marketplace, Order ID, SKU, Product Name, Amount, Currency, Category)
CSV Import Modal for Amazon Orders Report
Filtering & Search by SKU, Order ID, Date, Marketplace

core_views.title: Gider Kaydı (Expenses)
features: Expense Form (FBA Fees, PPC Advertising, COGS / Ürün Maliyeti, Shipping, Refunds, Monthly Subscription)

core_views.title: Amazon Ödemeleri & Bakiye Takibi
features: Net Payout vs Pending Reserve Balance Tracker

core_views.title: P&L / Kar-Zarar Raporu
features: Detailed Waterfall P&L Table (Gross Sales -> Discounts -> Refunds -> Net Sales -> COGS -> FBA Fees -> PPC -> Net Profit)
Date Range Selector (Bugün, Bu Hafta, Bu Ay, Son 90 Gün, Özel)

core_views.title: Mağaza & Pazar Yeri Yönetimi
features: Create New Seller Store (e.g., 'E-Com Empire EU')
Assign Active Marketplaces per Store (US, CA, MX, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, AU)

interactive_states_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: MANDATORY: Every input, button, tab, dropdown, table row, and modal must contain unique kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='store-switcher-dropdown', data-testid='income-submit-button', data-testid='kpi-net-profit-card').
interactive_states_and_accessibility.dropdown_backgrounds: NEVER use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, select menus, or popovers. Always use solid bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 with shadow-lg and border border-slate-200.
interactive_states_and_accessibility.hover_contrast: Ensure explicit hover states like hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white or hover:bg-emerald-700 hover:text-white.
interactive_states_and_accessibility.toast_notifications: Use sonner (imported from @/components/ui/sonner) for instant feedback on record saving, CSV imports, store switches, and errors.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use modern pill-shaped or sharp rounded buttons with responsive hover & active animations.
Do NOT center align main app container; maintain natural left-aligned data reading flow.
Add explicit data-testid to every interactive component.
Keep standard light theme crisp and high-contrast, utilizing tinting for table stripes and hover states.
Ensure all financial figures display appropriate currency symbols according to selected marketplace or default store currency.
